north_star: A trustworthy self-improving AI agent that runs consistently across terminal, messaging, desktop, and remote environments.
wedge: One provider-agnostic agent runtime with durable skills, memory, tools, profiles, and messaging gateways.
target_user: Developers and operators who want an autonomous agent they control across local and hosted environments.
core_promise: Hermes can understand, execute, verify, and learn from real work without locking the user to one model provider or platform.
product_principles: Preserve prompt-cache stability and strict message-role alternation.
Keep the core narrow; expand capabilities through existing abstractions, CLI, skills, plugins, and MCP.
Prefer real end-to-end proof over mock-only confidence.
non_goals: Coupling otherwise isolated profiles through implicit shared state.
Adding speculative core tools or extension hooks without a concrete consumer.
Outbound telemetry or attribution without explicit opt-in.
success_metrics: Canonical local verification passes for every finished task.
Prompt caching, role alternation, profile isolation, and security boundaries remain intact.
